title: Pinball Pete's
specs: Family-owned and operated since 1977 with deep ties to East Lansing and Ann Arbor communities
Classic arcade atmosphere with vintage and modern games, pinball machines, billiards, air hockey, and redemption games
Tickets earned can be saved indefinitely and redeemed at either location
All games run on quarters; guests exchange cash for quarters on-site
Guests bring cash for quarters; no credit cards accepted
Entire arcade can be rented for private parties and birthday celebrations
Private parties can be for birthdays, family gatherings, corporate events, and group outings

blurb: Pinball Pete's is a family-run arcade established in 1977 with locations in Ann Arbor and East Lansing, Michigan. Guests play classic arcade games, pinball machines, billiards, air hockey, and redemption games that award tickets redeemable for prizes. The arcade offers private party rentals with exclusive access to all games and machine rentals for businesses.
extraNote: Tickets from redemption games never expire and are interchangeable between Ann Arbor and East Lansing locations · Guests bring their own food, cake, snacks, and non-alcoholic beverages to private parties · Private party rental dates should be booked early due to popularity · Flexibility for date or guest count changes depends on availability
